title.zh: 卷十七 志第七 禮樂七
title.raw: 卷十七 志第七 禮樂七 Volume 17 Treatises 7: Rites and Music 7

sentences.zh: 嘉禮一

translations.literal: Auspicious Rites One
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious Rites I

sentences.zh: 四曰嘉禮。

translations.literal: Fourth is auspicious rites.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth category is auspicious rites.

sentences.zh: 皇帝加元服

translations.literal: The emperor receives the additional cap of adulthood
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's Coming-of-Age Investiture

sentences.zh: 皇帝加元服。

translations.literal: The emperor receives the additional cap of adulthood.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor receives the additional cap of adulthood.

sentences.zh: 有司卜日，告於天地宗廟。

translations.literal: The relevant officials divine the day and announce it to Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: Officials select the day by divination and report it to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 前一日，尚舍設席於太極殿中楹之間，莞筵紛純，加藻席緇純，加次席黼純。

translations.literal: On the day before, the Palace Provisioners set mats between the central pillars of the Hall of Supreme Ultimate: rush mats with dark borders, upon them algae mats with black borders, upon them secondary mats with embroidered borders.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, the Palace Provisioners lay mats between the central pillars of the Hall of Supreme Ultimate—rush mats with dark trim, algae mats with black trim, and secondary mats with embroidered trim.

sentences.zh: 有司設次，展縣，設案，陣車輦。

translations.literal: The relevant officials set pavilions, deploy the suspended bells, set tables, and array the chariots and palanquins.
translations.idiomatic: Officials arrange side pavilions, hang the bell-chimes, set offering tables, and line up chariots and palanquins.

sentences.zh: 設文官五品以上位於縣東，武官于縣西，六品以下皆於橫街之南，北上。

translations.literal: Civil officials of the fifth rank and above were placed east of the bells; military officials west of the bells; those of the sixth rank and below all south of the Cross Street, facing north and ascending west.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth-rank civil officials and above stood east of the bells; military officials west; sixth rank and below lined the south side of Cross Street, facing north with west at their right.

sentences.zh: 朝集使分方于文武官當品之下，諸親位於四品、五品之下，皇宗親在東，異姓親在西。

translations.literal: Assembly envoys were apportioned by direction below officials of their respective ranks; kinsmen below the fourth and fifth ranks—with imperial clansmen on the east and unrelated kin on the west.
translations.idiomatic: Regional assembly envoys took positions by quarter below officials of matching rank; relatives below fourth and fifth rank—with imperial clans east, unrelated kin west.

sentences.zh: 籓客分方各於朝集使六品之南，諸州使人於朝集使九品之後。

translations.literal: Border guests were apportioned by direction each south of sixth-rank assembly envoys; envoys from the prefectures behind ninth-rank assembly envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign guests were placed by direction south of sixth-rank assembly envoys; prefectural envoys behind ninth-rank assembly envoys.

sentences.zh: 又設太師、太尉位於橫街之南，道東，北面西上。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor were also placed south of Cross Street, east of the road, facing north with west at their right.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor stood south of Cross Street on the east side of the road, facing north with west at their right.

sentences.zh: 典儀于縣東北，贊者二人在南，少退，俱西向。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies northeast of the bells; two presenters south of him, slightly withdrawn, all facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies northeast of the bells; two announcers south of him, slightly back, all facing west.

sentences.zh: 又設門外位於東西朝堂，如元日。

translations.literal: Outside the gates, positions were also set in the east and west audience halls, as on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: Gate positions were set in the east and west audience halls as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 其日，侍中版奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: On that day, the attendant-in-chief petitioned on the tally board, "Request mid-solemnity."
translations.idiomatic: That day the attendant-in-chief reported on the tally board, "Request mid-solemnity."

sentences.zh: 太樂令、鼓吹令帥工人入就位。

translations.literal: The Director of Imperial Music and the Director of Processional Music led the musicians in to take their places.
translations.idiomatic: The Directors of Imperial and Processional Music led musicians to their stations.

sentences.zh: 有司設罍洗于阼階東南，設席于東房內，近西，張帷於東序外。

translations.literal: The relevant officials set a lavabo east-southeast of the eastern steps; a mat inside the east chamber near the west wall; curtains hung outside the east wing.
translations.idiomatic: Officials placed a lavabo southeast of the eastern steps; a mat in the east inner chamber near the west wall; curtains outside the east wing.

sentences.zh: 殿中監陳袞服于內席，東領，緇纚、玉簪及櫛三物同箱，在服南。

translations.literal: The palace superintendent displayed the dragon robes on the inner mat, collar to the east; black headband, jade hairpin, and comb in one box south of the robes.
translations.idiomatic: The palace superintendent laid out dragon robes on the inner mat, collar east; black headband, jade pin, and comb together in a box south of the robes.

sentences.zh: 又設莞筵一，紛純，加藻席緇純，加次席黼純，在南。

translations.literal: Another rush mat with dark border was set, with algae mat with black border and secondary mat with embroidered border, to the south.
translations.idiomatic: Another rush mat with dark trim, algae mat with black trim, and secondary embroidered mat were placed to the south.

sentences.zh: 尚食實醴尊於東序外帷內，坫在尊北，實角、觶、柶各一。

translations.literal: The Imperial Commissary filled the ceremonial wine vessel in the curtain within the outer east wing; the altar mound north of the vessel, with horn, goblet, and ladle each one.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Commissary set the ceremonial wine vessel inside the east-wing curtain; the altar mound north of it, with one horn, goblet, and ladle each.

sentences.zh: 饌陳於尊西，籩、豆各十二；

translations.literal: Food offerings were arrayed west of the vessel: baskets and stands, twelve each;
translations.idiomatic: Offerings west of the vessel: twelve baskets and twelve stands each;

sentences.zh: 俎三，在籩、豆之北。

translations.literal: three trays north of the baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: three meat trays north of the baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 設罍洗於尊東。

translations.literal: A lavabo was set east of the vessel.
translations.idiomatic: A lavabo was placed east of the vessel.

sentences.zh: 袞冕、玉導置於箱。

translations.literal: Dragon coronet and jade hairpin guide were placed in the box.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon coronet and jade hairpin guide went in the box.

sentences.zh: 太常博士一人，立於西階下，東面。

translations.literal: One Erudite of the Imperial Sacrifices stood below the west steps, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite of the Imperial Sacrifices stood below the west steps, facing east.

sentences.zh: 諸侍衛之官俱詣閣奉迎，典儀帥贊者及群官以次入就位。

translations.literal: All guard officials went together to the gate to welcome; the master of ceremonies led presenters and officials in by rank to take their places.
translations.idiomatic: Guard officials went to the gate to welcome; the master of ceremonies led announcers and officials in by rank to their stations.

sentences.zh: 太常博士引太常卿升西階，立于西房外，當戶北向。

translations.literal: The Erudite led the Director of Imperial Sacrifices up the west steps to stand outside the west chamber, facing north at the door.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudite led the Director up the west steps to stand outside the west chamber, north-facing at the door.

sentences.zh: 侍中版奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: The attendant-in-chief petitioned on the tally board, "Outer preparations complete."
translations.idiomatic: The attendant-in-chief reported, "Outer preparations complete."

sentences.zh: 皇帝服空頂黑介幘、絳紗袍，出自西房，即御座立。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the open-topped black cap, crimson gauze robe, came out from the west chamber, and at once stood at the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Wearing open-topped black cap and crimson gauze robe, the emperor came from the west chamber and took the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 太師、太尉入就位。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor entered and took their places.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor entered to their stations.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called, "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " The presenters relayed it; all in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers relayed the call; everyone in place bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 太師升自西階，立於東階上，東面。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor ascended by the west steps and stood on the east steps, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor climbed the west steps and stood on the east landing, facing east.

sentences.zh: 太尉詣阼階下罍洗，盥手，升自東階，詣東房，取纚櫛箱進，跪奠於御座西端。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor went to the lavabo below the eastern steps, washed his hands, ascended by the east steps, went to the east chamber, took the headband-and-comb box forward, knelt, and set it at the west end of the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor washed at the lavabo below the east steps, entered the east chamber, brought the headband-and-comb box, knelt, and set it at the west end of the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 太師詣御座前跪奏曰：「坐。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor came before the imperial seat, knelt, and petitioned: "Be seated.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor knelt before the seat and said, "Be seated.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝坐。

translations.literal: " The emperor sat.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor sat.

sentences.zh: 太尉當前少左，跪，脫幘置於箱，櫛畢，設纚，興，少西，東面立。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor came forward slightly to the left, knelt, removed the cap and placed it in the box, combed the hair, set the headband, rose, moved slightly west, and stood facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor stepped forward left, knelt, removed the cap into the box, combed, set the headband, rose, stepped slightly west, and stood east-facing.

sentences.zh: 太師降，盥，受冕，右執頂，左執前，升自西階，當前少左，祝曰：「令月吉日，始加元服。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor descended, washed, received the coronet, right hand on the crown top, left on the front, ascended the west steps, came forward slightly left, and invoked: "On this auspicious day of this month, he first receives the additional cap of adulthood.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor descended, washed, took the coronet—right hand on the crown, left on the front—climbed the west steps, stepped forward left, and prayed: "On this good day of this month, he first receives the cap of adulthood.

sentences.zh: 壽考惟祺，以介景福。

translations.literal: Long life and blessing; great fortune attend.
translations.idiomatic: May long life and blessing bring vast fortune.

sentences.zh: 」乃跪，冠，興，復西階上位。

translations.literal: " Then he knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned to his place on the west steps.
translations.idiomatic: " He knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned to the west-step position.

sentences.zh: 太尉前，少左，跪，設簪，結纓，興，復位。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor came forward slightly left, knelt, set the hairpin, tied the cap tassel, rose, and returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor stepped forward left, knelt, set the hairpin and tied the cap tassel, rose, and returned.

sentences.zh: 皇帝興，適東房。

translations.literal: The emperor rose and went to the east chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rose and went to the east chamber.

sentences.zh: 殿中監徹櫛纚箱以退。

translations.literal: The palace superintendent removed the comb-and-headband box and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The palace superintendent took away the comb-and-headband box and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇帝袞服出，即席南向坐。

translations.literal: The emperor came out in dragon robes and at once sat on the mat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor emerged in dragon robes and sat facing south on the mat.

sentences.zh: 太尉詣序外帷內，盥手，洗觶，酌醴，加柶覆之，面葉，立於序內，南面。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor went within the curtain outside the wing, washed his hands, rinsed the goblet, poured the ceremonial wine, placed the ladle covering it with the handle outward, and stood within the wing facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor entered the outer east-wing curtain, washed, rinsed the goblet, poured ceremonial wine, covered it with ladle handle out, and stood inside facing south.

sentences.zh: 太師進，受醴，面柄，前，北向祝曰：「甘醴唯厚，嘉薦令芳。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor advanced, received the wine, handle toward him, came forward, and facing north invoked: "Sweet wine is rich; fine offerings fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor advanced, received the wine handle-first, stepped forward, and north-facing prayed: "Sweet wine is rich; fine offerings fragrant.

sentences.zh: 承天之休，壽考不忘。

translations.literal: Heaven's favor; long life unforgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's favor—may long life never be forgotten.

sentences.zh: 」退，降立於西階下，東面。

translations.literal: " He withdrew and descended to stand below the west steps, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: " He withdrew and stood below the west steps, facing east.

sentences.zh: 將祝，殿中監率進饌者奉饌設于前，皇帝左執觶，右取脯，擩於棨，祭於籩、豆之間。

translations.literal: When about to invoke, the palace superintendent led food-bearers to set food before him; the emperor left hand held the goblet, right took dried meat, dipped it on the offering stick, and sacrificed between baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Before the prayer, the palace superintendent led servers to set food; the emperor held the goblet left, took dried meat right, dipped it on the stick, and offered between baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 太尉取鸑一以進，皇帝奠觶于薦西，受棨，舒左執本，右絕末以祭，上左手嚌之，授太尉。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor took one sliced bird to present; the emperor set the goblet west of the offering mat, received the stick, extended left hand on the base, right severed the end to sacrifice, tasted with the left hand, and handed it to the Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor presented one sliced bird; the emperor set the goblet west of the mat, took the stick, left on the base, right severed the tip to offer, tasted with the left hand, and gave it to the Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 太尉加于俎，降，立于太師之南。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor placed it on the tray, descended, and stood south of the Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor set it on the tray, descended, and stood south of the Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 皇帝帨手取觶，以柶祭醴，啐醴，建柶，奠觶於薦東。

translations.literal: The emperor wiped his hands, took the goblet, sacrificed to the wine with the ladle, tasted the wine, set the ladle upright, and placed the goblet east of the offering mat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wiped his hands, took the goblet, offered to the wine with the ladle, tasted the wine, set the ladle upright, and placed the goblet east of the mat.

sentences.zh: 太師、太尉復橫街南位。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor returned to their places south of Cross Street.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor returned south of Cross Street.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called, "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " The presenters relayed it; all in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers relayed; all in place bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 太師、太尉出。

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor departed.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor and Grand Mentor left.

sentences.zh: 侍中前，跪奏「禮畢」。

translations.literal: The attendant-in-chief came forward and knelt to petition, "The rite is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The attendant-in-chief knelt and reported, "The rite is complete."

sentences.zh: 皇帝興，入自東房，在位者以次出。

translations.literal: The emperor rose, entered by the east chamber; those in position departed in order.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rose, entered by the east chamber; attendees left in order.

sentences.zh: 皇太子加元服

translations.literal: The heir apparent receives the additional cap of adulthood
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince's Coming-of-Age Investiture

sentences.zh: 皇太子加元服。

translations.literal: The heir apparent receives the additional cap of adulthood.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince receives the additional cap of adulthood.

sentences.zh: 有司豫奏司徒一人為賓，卿一人為贊冠，吏部承以戒之。

translations.literal: The relevant officials beforehand memorialized one Minister of Education as guest and one minister as cap-assistant; the Ministry of Personnel conveyed the admonition.
translations.idiomatic: Officials beforehand nominated one Minister of Education as guest and one minister as cap-assistant; the Ministry of Personnel delivered the charge.

sentences.zh: 前一日，尚舍設禦幄於太極殿，有司設群官之次位，展縣，設案，陳車輿，皆如皇帝之冠。

translations.literal: On the day before, the Palace Provisioners set the imperial canopy in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate; officials set officials' pavilions, deployed bells, set tables, arrayed chariots—all as for the emperor's crowning.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, Palace Provisioners set the imperial canopy in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate; officials arranged ranks, bells, tables, and chariots as for the emperor's crowning.

sentences.zh: 設賓受命位於橫街南道東，贊冠位於其後，少東，皆北面。

translations.literal: The guest's place to receive the charge was set south of Cross Street on the east side of the road; the cap-assistant behind him, slightly east, both facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's charge-reception spot was south of Cross Street on the road's east side; the cap-assistant behind, slightly east—both north-facing.

sentences.zh: 又設文武官門外位於順天門外道東、西。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials' outside-the-gate positions were also set east and west outside the Gate of Compliance with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Outside positions for civil and military officials were set east and west outside the Gate of Compliance with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 其日，侍中奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: On that day, the attendant-in-chief petitioned, "Request mid-solemnity."
translations.idiomatic: That day the attendant-in-chief reported, "Request mid-solemnity."

sentences.zh: 群官有司皆就位。

translations.literal: All officials and relevant offices took their places.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and relevant offices took their stations.

sentences.zh: 賓、贊入，立於太極門外道東，西面。

translations.literal: Guest and assistant entered and stood east outside the Gate of Supreme Ultimate, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and assistant entered and stood east outside the Gate of Supreme Ultimate, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎引主節持幡節，中書侍郎引制書案，立于樂縣東南，西面北上。

translations.literal: The Gentleman of the Yellow Gate led the chief protocol officer with banner and staff; the Vice Director of the Secretariat led the edict case—they stood southeast of the music bells, west-facing with north at their right.
translations.idiomatic: The Gentleman of the Yellow Gate led the chief protocol officer with banner and staff; the Vice Director of the Secretariat led the edict case—southeast of the bells, west-facing, north at their right.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: The attendant-in-chief petitioned, "Outer preparations complete."
translations.idiomatic: The attendant-in-chief reported, "Outer preparations complete."

sentences.zh: 皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，乘輿出自西房，即禦坐。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the penetrating-heaven cap and crimson gauze robe, rode the palanquin out from the west chamber, and at once took the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Wearing penetrating-heaven cap and crimson gauze robe, the emperor rode out from the west chamber and took the seat.

sentences.zh: 賓、贊入就位。

translations.literal: Guest and assistant entered and took their places.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and assistant entered to their stations.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called, "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」在位皆再拜。

translations.literal: " All in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " Everyone in place bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 侍中及舍人前承制，侍中降至賓前，稱「有制」。

translations.literal: The attendant-in-chief and attendants advanced to receive the edict; the attendant-in-chief descended to the guest and announced, "There is an edict."
translations.idiomatic: The attendant-in-chief and clerks advanced for the edict; the attendant-in-chief descended to the guest and said, "There is an edict."

sentences.zh: 公再拜。

translations.literal: The duke bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The duke bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 侍中曰：「將加冠於某之首，公其將事。

translations.literal: The attendant-in-chief said: "The cap will be placed on So-and-so's head; my lord, undertake the office.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant-in-chief said, "The cap will be placed on the prince's head; undertake the office, my lord.

sentences.zh: 」公少進，北面再拜稽首，辭曰：「臣不敏，恐不能供事，敢辭。

translations.literal: " The duke advanced slightly, bowed twice to the north and knocked his head, declining: "Your servant is not adept and fears he cannot perform the service—I venture to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The duke stepped forward, kowtowed north, and declined: "I am not adept and fear I cannot serve—I venture to decline."

sentences.zh: 」侍中升奏，又承制降，稱：「制旨，公其將事，無辭。

translations.literal: " The attendant-in-chief ascended to report, then again received the edict and descended, saying: "By imperial intent, my lord shall undertake the office—no declining.
translations.idiomatic: " The attendant-in-chief reported upward, descended again, and said, "By imperial intent you shall serve—no declining."

sentences.zh: 」公再拜。

translations.literal: " The duke bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The duke bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 侍中、舍人至卿前稱敕旨，卿再拜。

translations.literal: The attendant-in-chief and attendants went before the minister and announced the edict's intent; the minister bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant-in-chief and clerks announced the edict to the minister; the minister bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 侍中曰：「將加冠於某之首，卿宜贊冠。

translations.literal: The attendant-in-chief said: "The cap will be placed on So-and-so's head; you, minister, should assist the crowning.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant-in-chief said, "The cap will be placed on the prince's head; assist the crowning, minister."

sentences.zh: 」卿再拜。

translations.literal: " The minister bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The minister bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎執節立于賓東北，西面。

translations.literal: The Gentleman of the Yellow Gate held the staff and stood northeast of the guest, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The Gentleman of the Yellow Gate held the staff northeast of the guest, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓再拜受節，付於主節，又再拜。

translations.literal: The guest bowed twice to receive the staff, handed it to the chief protocol officer, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed twice to receive the staff, gave it to the chief protocol officer, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎取制書立賓東北，西面，賓再拜，受制書，又再拜。

translations.literal: The Vice Director of the Secretariat took the edict and stood northeast of the guest, west-facing; the guest bowed twice, received the edict, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Director took the edict northeast of the guest, west-facing; the guest bowed twice, received it, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called, "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，在位皆再拜。

translations.literal: " The presenters relayed it; all in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers relayed; all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 賓、贊出，皇帝降坐，入自東房，在位者以次出。

translations.literal: Guest and assistant departed; the emperor left the seat and entered by the east chamber; those in position departed in order.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and assistant left; the emperor left the seat, entered by the east chamber; attendees left in order.

sentences.zh: 初，賓、贊出門，以制書置於案，引以幡節，威儀鐃吹及九品以上，皆詣東宮朝堂。

translations.literal: At first, when guest and assistant went out the gate, the edict was placed on the case; they led with banner and staff; honor guard, drums, and ninth rank and above all went to the Eastern Palace audience hall.
translations.idiomatic: When guest and assistant left, the edict was set on the case; they led with banner and staff; honor guard, drums, and ranks through ninth all went to the Eastern Palace audience hall.

sentences.zh: 冠前一日，衛尉設賓次於重明門外道西，南向，贊冠於其西南。

translations.literal: On the day before the crowning, the Commandant of the Guard set the guest's pavilion west outside the Gate of Double Brightness, facing south; the cap-assistant southwest of it.
translations.idiomatic: The day before crowning, the Commandant of the Guard set the guest pavilion west outside the Gate of Double Brightness, south-facing; the cap-assistant southwest of it.

sentences.zh: 又設次於門內道西，以待賓、贊。

translations.literal: Another pavilion was set west inside the gate on the road, to await guest and assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Another pavilion west inside the gate awaited guest and assistant.

sentences.zh: 又設皇太子位於閣外道東，西向。

translations.literal: The crown prince's position was also set east outside the pavilion, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's station was set east outside the pavilion, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 三師位於道西，三少位於其南，少退，俱東向。

translations.literal: The three tutors stood west of the road; the three juniors south of them, slightly back—all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Three tutors west of the road; three juniors south of them, slightly back—all east-facing.

sentences.zh: 又設軒縣于庭，皇太子受制位於縣北，解劍席于東北，皆北面。

translations.literal: Suspended bells were also set in the courtyard; the crown prince's edict-reception place north of the bells; sword-removal mats northeast—all facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Court bells were hung in the courtyard; the prince's edict station north of them; sword-removal mats northeast—all north-facing.

sentences.zh: 冠日平明，宮臣皆朝服，其餘公服，集於重明門外朝堂。

translations.literal: At dawn on crowning day, palace officials all wore court dress; the rest official dress, assembling at the audience hall outside the Gate of Double Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on crowning day, palace officials wore court dress; others official dress, gathering outside the Gate of Double Brightness.

sentences.zh: 宗正卿乘車侍從，詣左春坊權停。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Clan rode with attendants and halted temporarily at the Left Spring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Clan rode with attendants and paused at the Left Spring Palace.

sentences.zh: 左右二率各勒所部，屯門列仗。

translations.literal: The left and right commandants each mustered their sections and stationed guards at the gate in formation.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right commandants mustered their sections and posted guards at the gate.

sentences.zh: 左庶子版奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: The Left Chamberlain petitioned on the tally board, "Request mid-solemnity."
translations.idiomatic: The Left Chamberlain reported, "Request mid-solemnity."

sentences.zh: 群官有司入就位。

translations.literal: Officials and relevant offices entered and took their places.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and relevant offices entered to their stations.

sentences.zh: 設罍洗于東階東南。

translations.literal: A lavabo was set southeast of the east steps.
translations.idiomatic: A lavabo was placed southeast of the east steps.

sentences.zh: 設冠席於殿上東壁下少南，西向；

translations.literal: The crowning mat was set slightly south below the east wall of the hall, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: The crowning mat was laid slightly south under the hall's east wall, west-facing;

sentences.zh: 賓席於西階上，東向；

translations.literal: The guest's mat was on the west steps, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: The guest's seat on the west steps faced east;

sentences.zh: 主人席于皇太子席西南，西向；

translations.literal: the host's mat southwest of the crown prince's mat, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: the host's seat southwest of the prince's seat, west-facing;

sentences.zh: 三師席于冠席北，三少席于冠席南。

translations.literal: the three tutors' mats north of the crowning mat, the three juniors' south of the crowning mat.
translations.idiomatic: three tutors north of the crowning seat, three juniors south of it.

sentences.zh: 張帷於東序內，設褥席於帷中。

translations.literal: Curtains were hung within the east wing; cushioned mats set within the curtains.
translations.idiomatic: Curtains hung inside the east wing; cushioned mats within.

sentences.zh: 又張帷於序外冠席。

translations.literal: Curtains were also hung outside the wing at the crowning mat.
translations.idiomatic: More curtains hung outside the wing at the crowning seat.

sentences.zh: 內直郎陳服於帷內，東領北上：袞冕，金飾象笏；

translations.literal: The inner attendant displayed robes within the curtains, collars to the north ascending west: dragon robes, gold-trimmed ivory tablet;
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant laid out robes in the curtains, collars north ascending west: dragon robes and gold-trimmed ivory tablet;

sentences.zh: 遠遊冠。

translations.literal: the far-travel cap.
translations.idiomatic: the far-travel cap.

sentences.zh: 緇布冠，服玄衣、素裳、素韡、白紗中單、青領褾紘裾，履、襪，革帶、大帶，笏。

translations.literal: black cloth cap, with black upper garment, plain lower garment, plain knee-covers, white gauze inner robe, blue collar binding and lapel, shoes and socks, leather belt and great belt, tablet.
translations.idiomatic: Black cloth cap; black upper, plain lower, plain knee-covers; white gauze inner robe with blue collar and lapel; shoes, socks, leather and great belts; tablet.

sentences.zh: 緇纚、犀簪二物同箱，在服南。

translations.literal: black headband and rhinoceros hairpin in one box, south of the robes.
translations.idiomatic: Black headband and rhinoceros pin together in a box south of the robes.

sentences.zh: 櫛實於箱，又在南。

translations.literal: Comb in the box, again to the south.
translations.idiomatic: The comb in the box, farther south.

sentences.zh: 莞筵四，藻席四，又在南。

translations.literal: Four rush mats, four algae mats, again to the south.
translations.idiomatic: Four rush mats and four algae mats, again to the south.

sentences.zh: 良紘令實側尊甒醴於序外帷內，設罍洗於尊東，實巾一，角觶、柶各一。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonial Cords filled the side urn with dark wine in the curtain outside the wing, lavabo east of the urn, one cloth, horn goblet and ladle each one.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonial Cords set the side urn with dark wine inside the outer east-wing curtain; lavabo east of the urn; one cloth; one horn, goblet, and ladle each.

sentences.zh: 太官令實饌豆九、籩九於尊西，俎三在豆北。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Kitchen filled nine food stands and nine baskets west of the urn; three trays north of the stands.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Kitchen Director set nine food stands and nine baskets west of the urn; three trays north of the stands.

sentences.zh: 袞冕，遠遊三梁冠、黑介幘，緇布冠青組纓屬於冠，冠、冕各一箱。

translations.literal: Dragon robes; far-travel three-ridge cap and black cap, black cloth cap with blue cord tassel attached to the cap—coronet and cap each in one box.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon robes; far-travel three-ridge cap with black cap; black cloth cap with blue cord tassel on the cap—coronet and cap each in its own box.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎三人各執立於西階之西，東面北上。

translations.literal: Three Masters of Ceremonies each holding and standing west of the west steps, facing east ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Three Masters of Ceremonies stood west of the west steps, each holding regalia, east-facing with north at their right.

sentences.zh: 主人、贊冠者宗正卿為主人，庶子為贊冠者。

translations.literal: Host and cap-assistant: the Director of the Imperial Clan as host, the Chamberlain as cap-assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Host and cap-assistant: the Director of the Imperial Clan served as host; the Chamberlain as cap-assistant.

sentences.zh: 升，詣東序帷內少北、戶東，西立。

translations.literal: They ascended, went to within the east-wing curtain slightly north and east of the door, and stood west.
translations.idiomatic: They ascended to the east-wing curtain, slightly north and east of the door, and stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 典謁引群官以次入就位。

translations.literal: The master of audiences led officials in by rank to take their places.
translations.idiomatic: The master of audiences led officials in by rank to their stations.

sentences.zh: 初，賓、贊入次，左庶子版奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: At first, when guest and assistant entered the pavilion, the Left Chamberlain petitioned on the tally board, "Outer preparations complete."
translations.idiomatic: When guest and assistant entered the pavilion, the Left Chamberlain reported, "Outer preparations complete."

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引三師等入就閣外道西位，東面立。

translations.literal: The Master of Affairs led the three tutors and others in to the west position outside the pavilion, standing east.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Affairs led the three tutors to the west station outside the pavilion, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 皇太子空頂黑介幘、雙童髻、彩衣、紫褲褶、織成褾領、綠紳、烏皮履，乘輿以出。

translations.literal: The crown prince wore open-topped black cap, double child topknots, colored robe, purple trousers and jacket, brocade lapel, green sash, black leather shoes, and rode out in the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince wore open black cap, double child topknots, colored robe, purple trousers-jacket, brocade lapel, green sash, and black shoes, and rode out.

sentences.zh: 洗馬迎於閣門外，左庶子請降輿，洗馬引之道東位，西向立。

translations.literal: The Groom of the Heir welcomed outside the pavilion gate; the Left Chamberlain requested descent from the palanquin; the Groom led him to the east position on the road, standing west.
translations.idiomatic: The Groom of the Heir welcomed outside the gate; the Left Chamberlain asked him to descend; the Groom led him to the east roadside station, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 左庶子請再拜。

translations.literal: The Left Chamberlain requested a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Chamberlain called for a double bow.

sentences.zh: 三師、三少答拜。

translations.literal: The three tutors and three juniors returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The three tutors and three juniors returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 乃就階東南位。

translations.literal: Then he took the position southeast of the steps.
translations.idiomatic: He then took the station southeast of the steps.

sentences.zh: 三師在前，三少在後，千牛二人夾左右，其餘仗衛列于師、保之外。

translations.literal: The three tutors in front, three juniors behind; two Thousand-Ox men flanking left and right; the rest of the guard arrayed outside the tutors and protectors.
translations.idiomatic: Three tutors ahead, three juniors behind; two Thousand-Ox guards flanking; other guards outside the tutors and protectors.

sentences.zh: 皇太子乃出迎賓，至阼階東，西面立。

translations.literal: The crown prince then went out to welcome the guest, reaching the east of the eastern steps, standing west.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince went out to welcome the guest and stood west of the east steps.

sentences.zh: 宗正卿立於門東，西面。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Clan stood east of the gate, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Clan stood east of the gate, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓立於西，東面。

translations.literal: The guest stood to the west, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The guest stood west, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 宗正卿再拜，賓不答拜。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Clan bowed twice; the guest did not return the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The Director bowed twice; the guest did not return the bow.

sentences.zh: 賓入，主人從入，立于縣東北，西面。

translations.literal: The guest entered; the host followed in and stood northeast of the bells, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest entered; the host followed and stood northeast of the bells, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓入，贊冠者從，賓詣殿階間，南面。

translations.literal: The guest entered; the cap-assistant followed; the guest went to between the hall steps, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest entered with the cap-assistant; the guest stood between the hall steps, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者立於賓西南，東面。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant stood southwest of the guest, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant stood southwest of the guest, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 節在賓東少南，西面。

translations.literal: The staff east of the guest slightly south, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The staff stood east of the guest, slightly south, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 制案在贊冠西南，東面。

translations.literal: The edict case southwest of the cap-assistant, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The edict case southwest of the cap-assistant, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓執制，皇太子詣受制位，北面立。

translations.literal: The guest held the edict; the crown prince went to the edict-reception position and stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The guest held the edict; the crown prince went to the edict station and stood north-facing.

sentences.zh: 主節脫節衣，賓稱「有制」。

translations.literal: The chief protocol officer removed the staff cover; the guest announced, "There is an edict."
translations.idiomatic: The chief protocol officer removed the staff cover; the guest said, "There is an edict."

sentences.zh: 皇太子再拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 宣詔曰：「有制，皇太子某，吉日元服，率由舊章，命太尉某就宮展禮。

translations.literal: The edict was proclaimed: "By edict: the crown prince So-and-so, on this auspicious day receives the additional cap of adulthood; follow the old statutes; we appoint Grand Mentor So-and-so to go to the palace and perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: The edict ran: "By edict: Crown Prince So-and-so, on this auspicious day receives the cap of adulthood per ancient statute; Grand Mentor So-and-so is ordered to the palace to perform the rite.

sentences.zh: 」皇太子再拜。

translations.literal: " The crown prince bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 少傅進詣賓前，受制書，以授皇太子，付于庶子。

translations.literal: The Junior Tutor advanced to the guest, received the written edict, and handed it to the crown prince, who gave it to the Chamberlain.
translations.idiomatic: The Junior Tutor advanced, received the written edict, handed it to the crown prince, who gave it to the Chamberlain.

sentences.zh: 皇太子升東階，入於東序帷內，近北，南面立。

translations.literal: The crown prince ascended the east steps, entered the east-wing curtain near the north, and stood facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince climbed the east steps, entered the east-wing curtain near the north, and stood south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓升西階，及宗正卿各立席後。

translations.literal: The guest ascended the west steps; he and the Director of the Imperial Clan each stood behind the mats.
translations.idiomatic: The guest climbed the west steps; he and the Director each stood behind the seats.

sentences.zh: 初，賓升，贊冠者詣罍洗，盥手，升自東階帷內，于主人冠贊之南，俱西面。

translations.literal: At first, when the guest ascended, the cap-assistant went to the lavabo, washed his hands, ascended by the east steps within the curtain, south of the host cap-assistant, all facing west.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest ascended, the cap-assistant washed at the lavabo, entered the east-wing curtain by the east steps, south of the host's cap-assistant—all west-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人贊冠者引皇太子出，立于席東，西面。

translations.literal: The host cap-assistant led the crown prince out to stand east of the mat, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host's cap-assistant led the crown prince out east of the seat, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者取纚、櫛二箱，坐奠於筵。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant took the headband and comb boxes and set them seated on the mat.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's cap-assistant set the headband and comb boxes on the mat.

sentences.zh: 皇太子進，升筵，西面坐。

translations.literal: The crown prince advanced, ascended the mat, and sat facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince advanced, mounted the seat, and sat west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊冠者東面坐，脫幘置於箱，櫛畢，設纚，興，少北，南面立。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant sat facing east, removed the cap into the box, combed, set the headband, rose, moved slightly north, and stood facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's cap-assistant sat east-facing, removed the cap into the box, combed, set the headband, rose slightly north, and stood south-facing.

sentences.zh: 執緇布冠升，賓降一等受之，右執頂，左執前，進，東向立，祝曰：「令月吉日，始加元服。

translations.literal: The black-cloth-cap bearer ascended; the guest descended one step rank to receive it, right hand on crown top, left on front, advanced, stood east, and invoked: "On this auspicious day of this month, he first receives the additional cap of adulthood.
translations.idiomatic: The black-cloth-cap bearer ascended; the guest stepped down one rank to receive it—right on the crown, left on the front—advanced, stood east, and prayed: "On this good day of this month, he first receives the cap of adulthood.

sentences.zh: 棄厥幼志，慎其成德。

translations.literal: Abandon his youthful aims; be careful of his mature virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Leave childish aims behind; guard mature virtue.

sentences.zh: 壽考惟祺，以介景福。

translations.literal: Long life and blessing; great fortune attend.
translations.idiomatic: May long life and blessing bring vast fortune.

sentences.zh: 」乃跪，冠，興，復位。

translations.literal: " Then he knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: " He knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned.

sentences.zh: 皇太子東面立，賓揖皇太子，贊冠者引適東序帷內，服玄衣素裳之服以出，立于席東，西面。

translations.literal: The crown prince stood facing east; the guest bowed to the crown prince; the cap-assistant led him to the east-wing curtain, dressed in black upper and plain lower garments, came out, and stood east of the mat facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince stood east-facing; the guest bowed; the cap-assistant led him into the east-wing curtain, dressed him in black upper and plain lower garments, and brought him out west-facing east of the seat.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇太子升筵，西向坐。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the crown prince to ascend the mat and sit facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed the prince up to the seat to sit west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊冠者進，跪脫緇布冠置於箱，興，復位。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant advanced, knelt, removed the black cloth cap into the box, rose, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's cap-assistant knelt, removed the black cloth cap into the box, rose, and returned.

sentences.zh: 賓降二等，受遠遊冠，右執頂，左執前，進，祝曰：「吉月令辰，乃申嘉服，克敬威儀，式昭厥德。

translations.literal: The guest descended two ranks, received the far-travel cap, right on top, left on front, advanced, and invoked: "On this auspicious month and hour, he now puts on fine dress; respectfully keep dignified bearing to display his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The guest stepped down two ranks, took the far-travel cap, advanced, and prayed: "On this auspicious month and hour he dons fine dress; keep dignified bearing to show his virtue.

sentences.zh: 眉壽萬歲，永壽胡福。

translations.literal: Brow long-lived ten thousand years; eternal life and great blessing.
translations.idiomatic: May his brow live ten thousand years; eternal life and blessing.

sentences.zh: 」乃跪，冠，興，復位。

translations.literal: " Then he knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: " He knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned.

sentences.zh: 皇太子興，賓揖皇太子，贊冠者引適東序帷內，朝服以出，立于席東，西面。

translations.literal: The crown prince rose; the guest bowed to the crown prince; the cap-assistant led him to the east-wing curtain, dressed in court robes, came out, and stood east of the mat facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The prince rose; the guest bowed; the cap-assistant dressed him in court robes in the east-wing curtain and brought him out west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇太子升筵坐，賓之贊冠者跪脫遠遊冠，興，復位。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the crown prince to ascend the mat and sit; the guest's cap-assistant knelt, removed the far-travel cap, rose, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed the prince to the seat; the cap-assistant knelt, removed the far-travel cap, rose, and returned.

sentences.zh: 賓降三等受冕，右執頂，左執前，進，祝曰：「以歲之正，以月之令。

translations.literal: The guest descended three ranks, received the coronet, right on top, left on front, advanced, and invoked: "By the correctness of the year, by the ordinance of the month.
translations.idiomatic: The guest stepped down three ranks, took the coronet, advanced, and prayed: "By the year's correctness, by the month's ordinance.

sentences.zh: 咸加其服，以成厥德。

translations.literal: All add their dress to complete his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: May added dress complete his virtue.

sentences.zh: 萬壽無疆，承天之慶。

translations.literal: Ten thousand years without limit; receive Heaven's celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand years without end; receive Heaven's celebration.

sentences.zh: 」乃跪，冠，興，復位。

translations.literal: " Then he knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: " He knelt, crowned him, rose, and returned.

sentences.zh: 每冠，皆贊冠者跪設簪、結纓。

translations.literal: At each crowning, the cap-assistant knelt to set hairpin and tie cap tassel.
translations.idiomatic: At each crowning the cap-assistant knelt to set pin and tie the cap tassel.

sentences.zh: 皇太子興，賓揖皇太子適東序，服袞冕之服以出，立于席東，西面。

translations.literal: The crown prince rose; the guest bowed to the crown prince to go to the east wing; dressed in dragon robes and came out to stand east of the mat facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The prince rose; the guest bowed him to the east wing; he emerged in dragon robes west-facing east of the seat.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者徹纚、櫛箱以入，又取筵入於帷內。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant removed the headband and comb boxes and entered; also took the mats into the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant took the headband and comb boxes in and carried the mats into the curtain.

sentences.zh: 主人贊冠者又設醴，皇太子席于室戶西，南向，下莞上藻。

translations.literal: The host cap-assistant again set the wine; the crown prince's mat west of the chamber door, facing south, rush below and algae above.
translations.idiomatic: The host's cap-assistant set the wine again; the prince's seat west of the chamber door, south-facing, rush below and algae above.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊冠者於東序外帷內，盥手洗觶。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant within the curtain outside the east wing washed his hands and rinsed the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's cap-assistant washed and rinsed the goblet inside the outer east-wing curtain.

sentences.zh: 典膳郎酌醴，加柶覆之，面柄，授贊冠，立於序內，南面。

translations.literal: The Director of Palace Food poured the wine, placed the ladle covering it with handle outward, handed it to the cap-assistant, who stood within the wing facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Palace Food poured wine, covered it ladle handle out, gave it to the cap-assistant, who stood inside the wing south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇太子就筵西，南面立。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the crown prince to approach the west of the mat and stand facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed the prince to the seat's west to stand south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓進，受醴，加柶，面柄，進，北向立，祝曰：「甘醴唯厚，嘉薦令芳。

translations.literal: The guest advanced, received the wine, placed the ladle, handle outward, advanced, stood north, and invoked: "Sweet wine is rich; fine offerings fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: The guest advanced, received the wine ladle handle out, stepped forward north-facing, and prayed: "Sweet wine is rich; fine offerings fragrant.

sentences.zh: 拜受祭之，以定厥祥。

translations.literal: Bow to receive and sacrifice it, to fix his auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: Bow, receive, and offer it to fix his good fortune.

sentences.zh: 承天之休，壽考不忘。

translations.literal: Heaven's favor; long life unforgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's favor—may long life never be forgotten.

sentences.zh: 」皇太子拜，受觶。

translations.literal: " The crown prince bowed and received the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince bowed and received the goblet.

sentences.zh: 賓復位，東面答拜。

translations.literal: The guest returned to his place and answered the bow facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The guest returned east-facing and answered the bow.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者與進饌者奉饌設於筵前，皇太子升筵坐，左執觶，右取脯，擩於棨，祭於籩、豆之間。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant and food-bearers set food before the mat; the crown prince ascended the mat and sat, left hand on the goblet, right taking dried meat, dipping on the stick, sacrificing between baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Cap-assistant and servers set food; the prince sat on the seat, goblet in left hand, took dried meat right, dipped on the stick, and offered between baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者取韭菹，遍擩於豆，以授皇太子，又祭於籩、豆之間。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant took leek pickle, dipped it throughout the stand, handed it to the crown prince, who again sacrificed between baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant took leek pickle, dipped it across the stand, gave it to the prince, who offered again between baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者取鸑一，以授皇太子，皇太子奠觶于薦西，興，受鸑，卻左手執本坐，繚右手絕末以祭。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant took one sliced bird and handed it to the crown prince; the crown prince set the goblet west of the offering mat, rose, received the bird, sat back with left hand on the base, wound the right hand severing the end to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant gave one sliced bird; the prince set the goblet west of the mat, rose, received the bird, sat with left on the base, right severing the tip to offer.

sentences.zh: 止，左手嚌之，興，以授贊冠者，加於俎。

translations.literal: He stopped, tasted with the left hand, rose, handed it to the cap-assistant, who placed it on the tray.
translations.idiomatic: He tasted with the left hand, rose, gave it to the cap-assistant, who set it on the tray.

sentences.zh: 皇太子坐，帨手取觶，以柶祭醴三，始扱一祭，又扱再祭，加柶於觶，面葉，興，筵末坐，啐醴，建柶，興，降筵西，南面坐，奠觶，再拜，執觶，興。

translations.literal: The crown prince sat, wiped his hands, took the goblet, sacrificed to the wine with the ladle three times—first dip one sacrifice, second dip two sacrifices—placed the ladle on the goblet with handle outward, rose, sat at the mat's end, tasted the wine, set the ladle upright, rose, descended west of the mat, sat facing south, set down the goblet, bowed twice, took up the goblet, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The prince sat, wiped his hands, took the goblet, offered to the wine three times—first one dip, then two—set the ladle on the goblet handle out, rose, sat at the seat's end, tasted the wine, set the ladle upright, descended west of the seat south-facing, set down the goblet, bowed twice, and rose with the goblet.

sentences.zh: 賓答拜。

translations.literal: The guest answered the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 皇太子降，立於西階之東，南面。

translations.literal: The crown prince descended and stood east of the west steps, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince descended to stand east of the west steps, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓降，立於西階之西少南，贊冠隨降，立於賓西南，皆東面。

translations.literal: The guest descended and stood west of the west steps slightly south; the cap-assistant followed down and stood southwest of the guest—all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The guest descended west of the west steps, slightly south; the cap-assistant followed southwest of the guest—all east-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓少進，字之，祝曰：「禮儀既備，令月吉日。

translations.literal: The guest advanced slightly and conferred the style name, invoking: "The rites and observances are complete; on this auspicious day of this month.
translations.idiomatic: The guest stepped forward to confer the style name: "Rites are complete on this good day of this month.

sentences.zh: 昭告厥字，君子攸宜。

translations.literal: Proclaim his style name; fitting for a gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim his style name—fit for a gentleman.

sentences.zh: 宜之於嘏，永受保之。

translations.literal: Fitting for blessing; may he forever receive and keep it.
translations.idiomatic: Fit for blessing; may he receive and keep it forever.

sentences.zh: 奉敕字某。

translations.literal: By edict the style name is So-and-so.
translations.idiomatic: By edict the style name is So-and-so.

sentences.zh: 」皇太子再拜曰：「某雖不敏，敢不祗奉。

translations.literal: " The crown prince bowed twice and said: "Though I am not adept, I venture not to fail in reverent obedience.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince bowed twice and said, "Though I am not adept, I dare not fail in reverent obedience.

sentences.zh: 」又再拜。

translations.literal: " He bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 洗馬引太子降阼階位，三師在南，北面，三少在北，南面立。

translations.literal: The Groom of the Heir led the crown prince down from the eastern steps; the three tutors south, facing north; the three juniors north, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The Groom led the prince down the east steps; three tutors south north-facing; three juniors north south-facing.

sentences.zh: 皇太子西面再拜，三師等各再拜以出。

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed twice facing west; the three tutors and others each bowed twice and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The prince bowed twice west-facing; the three tutors and others each bowed twice and left.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called, "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " The presenters relayed it; all in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers relayed; all in place bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 左庶子前，稱「禮畢」。

translations.literal: The Left Chamberlain came forward and announced, "The rite is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Left Chamberlain announced, "The rite is complete."

sentences.zh: 皇太子乘輿以入，侍臣從至閣，賓、贊及宗正卿出就會。

translations.literal: The crown prince rode in; attendants followed to the pavilion; guest, assistant, and Director of the Imperial Clan went out to the reception.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince rode in; attendants followed to the pavilion; guest, assistant, and Director went out to the reception.

sentences.zh: 皇子冠

translations.literal: Princes' crowning
translations.idiomatic: Crowning of Imperial Princes

sentences.zh: 皇子冠。

translations.literal: Princes' crowning.
translations.idiomatic: Crowning of imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 前三日，本司帥其屬筮日、筮賓於聽事。

translations.literal: Three days before, the responsible office led its subordinates to divine the day and guest in the audience hall.
translations.idiomatic: Three days prior, the responsible office led subordinates to divine the day and guest in the audience hall.

sentences.zh: 前二日，主人至賓之門外次，東面，賓立於阼階下，西面，儐者進于左，北面，受命出，立於門東，西面，曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: Two days before, the host came to the guest's outer pavilion, facing east; the guest stood below the eastern steps facing west; the usher advanced on the left, faced north, received the charge and came out, stood east of the gate facing west, and said: "I venture to ask the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before, the host came to the guest's outer pavilion east-facing; the guest stood below the east steps west-facing; the usher advanced left, faced north, received instructions, came out east of the gate west-facing, and said, "I venture to ask the matter.

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「皇子某王將加冠，請某公教之。

translations.literal: " The host said: "Prince So-and-so will receive the additional cap; I request Lord So-and-so to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said, "Prince So-and-so will be capped; I ask Lord So-and-so to instruct him."

sentences.zh: 」儐者入告，賓出，立于門左，西面，再拜。

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the guest came out, stood left of the gate facing west, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher reported inward; the guest came out, stood west of the gate's left, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 主人答拜。

translations.literal: The host returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The host returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主人曰：「皇子某王將加冠，願某公教之。

translations.literal: The host said: "Prince So-and-so will receive the additional cap; I wish Lord So-and-so to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: The host said, "Prince So-and-so will be capped; I wish Lord So-and-so to instruct him."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某不敏，恐不能共事，敢辭。

translations.literal: " The guest said: "I am not adept and fear I cannot share the service—I venture to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "I am not adept and fear I cannot serve—I venture to decline."

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「某猶願某公教之。

translations.literal: " The host said: "I still wish Lord So-and-so to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said, "I still ask Lord So-and-so to instruct him."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「王重有命，其敢不從。

translations.literal: " The guest said: "The prince has urgently commanded; how dare I not obey.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "The prince has urgently commanded; how dare I not obey?"

sentences.zh: 」主人再拜而還，賓拜送。

translations.literal: " The host bowed twice and returned; the guest bowed in farewell.
translations.idiomatic: " The host bowed twice and withdrew; the guest bowed him off.

sentences.zh: 命贊冠者亦如之。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant was charged likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant was charged in the same way.

sentences.zh: 冠之日，夙興，設洗于阼階東南，席于東房內西墉下。

translations.literal: On crowning day, at dawn they rose, set the lavabo southeast of the eastern steps, and a mat below the west wall of the east inner room.
translations.idiomatic: On crowning day at dawn they set a lavabo southeast of the east steps and a mat below the east room's west wall.

sentences.zh: 陳衣于席，東領北上：袞冕，遠遊冠，緇布冠。

translations.literal: Robes were displayed on the mat, collars to the north ascending west: dragon robes, far-travel cap, black cloth cap.
translations.idiomatic: Robes on the mat, collars north ascending west: dragon robes, far-travel cap, black cloth cap.

sentences.zh: 緇纚、犀簪、櫛實於箱，在服南。

translations.literal: Black headband, rhinoceros hairpin, and comb in the box, south of the robes.
translations.idiomatic: Black headband, rhinoceros pin, and comb in a box south of the robes.

sentences.zh: 莞筵、藻席各三，在南。

translations.literal: Three rush mats and three algae mats, to the south.
translations.idiomatic: Three rush mats and three algae mats to the south.

sentences.zh: 設尊于房戶之外西，兩甒玄酒在西，加勺冪。

translations.literal: The urn was set west outside the chamber door; two dark-wine jars west, with ladles and covers.
translations.idiomatic: An urn west outside the chamber door; two dark-wine jars west with ladles and covers.

sentences.zh: 設坫於尊東，置二爵於坫，加冪。

translations.literal: An altar mound east of the urn; two wine cups on the mound, with covers.
translations.idiomatic: An altar mound east of the urn; two wine cups on it, covered.

sentences.zh: 豆十、籩十在服北，俎三在籩、豆之北。

translations.literal: Ten stands and ten baskets north of the robes; three trays north of the baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Ten stands and ten baskets north of the robes; three trays north of them.

sentences.zh: 質明，賓、贊至於主人大門外之次，遠遊三梁、緇布冠各一箱，各一人執之，待於西階之西，東面北上。

translations.literal: At first light, guest and assistant came to the host's outer pavilion; far-travel three-ridge and black cloth caps each in one box, one bearer each, waiting west of the west steps facing east ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: At first light guest and assistant reached the host's outer pavilion; far-travel three-ridge and black cloth caps each in a box with a bearer, waiting west of the west steps east-facing.

sentences.zh: 設主人之席于阼階上，西面；

translations.literal: The host's mat was set on the eastern steps, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: The host's seat on the east steps faced west;

sentences.zh: 賓席於西階上，東面；

translations.literal: the guest's mat on the west steps, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: the guest's seat on the west steps faced east;

sentences.zh: 皇子席于室戶東、房戶西，南面。

translations.literal: the prince's mat east of the chamber door and west of the inner room door, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: the prince's seat east of the chamber door and west of the inner room door, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 俱下莞上藻。

translations.literal: All rush below and algae above.
translations.idiomatic: All with rush below and algae above.

sentences.zh: 主人立于阼階下，當東房，西面。

translations.literal: The host stood below the eastern steps opposite the east room, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood below the east steps opposite the east room, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 諸親立于罍洗東南，西面北上。

translations.literal: Kinsmen stood southeast of the lavabo, facing west ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Kinsmen stood southeast of the lavabo, west-facing with north at their right.

sentences.zh: 儐者立於門內道南，北面。

translations.literal: The usher stood south of the road inside the gate, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The usher stood south of the inner gate road, north-facing.

sentences.zh: 皇子雙童髻、空頂幘、彩褲褶、錦紳、烏皮履，立于房內，南面。

translations.literal: The prince wore double child topknots, open-topped cap, colored trousers and jacket, brocade sash, black leather shoes, and stood inside the room facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The prince wore double child topknots, open cap, colored trousers-jacket, brocade sash, black shoes, and stood in the room south-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人贊冠者立于房內戶東，西面。

translations.literal: The host cap-assistant stood east of the inner room door, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host's cap-assistant stood east of the inner room door, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓及贊冠者出，立於門西，贊冠者少退，俱東面北上。

translations.literal: Guest and cap-assistant came out and stood west of the gate; the cap-assistant slightly back—all facing east ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and cap-assistant came out west of the gate; the cap-assistant slightly behind—all east-facing.

sentences.zh: 儐者受命于主人，出，立於門東，西面，曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: The usher received the charge from the host, came out, stood east of the gate facing west, and said: "I venture to ask the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The usher took orders from the host, came out east of the gate west-facing, and said, "I venture to ask the matter."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「皇子某王將加冠、某謹應命。

translations.literal: " The guest said: "Prince So-and-so will receive the additional cap; I respectfully accept the charge.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "Prince So-and-so will be capped; I respectfully accept the charge."

sentences.zh: 」儐者入告，主人出迎賓，西面再拜，賓答拜。

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host came out to welcome the guest, bowed twice facing west; the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher reported; the host came out, bowed twice west-facing; the guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主人揖贊冠者，贊冠者報揖，主人又揖賓，賓報。

translations.literal: The host bowed to the cap-assistant; the cap-assistant returned the bow; the host again bowed to the guest; the guest returned it.
translations.idiomatic: The host bowed to the cap-assistant, who returned it; the host bowed again to the guest, who returned it.

sentences.zh: 主人入，賓、贊冠者以次入，及內門，主人揖賓，賓入，贊冠者從之。

translations.literal: The host entered; guest and cap-assistant entered in order; at the inner gate the host bowed to the guest; the guest entered; the cap-assistant followed.
translations.idiomatic: The host entered; guest and cap-assistant followed in order; at the inner gate the host bowed the guest in; the cap-assistant followed.

sentences.zh: 至內霤，將曲揖，賓報揖。

translations.literal: At the inner eaves, about to turn, they bowed; the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: At the inner eaves they bowed before turning; the guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 至階，主人立于階東，西面；

translations.literal: At the steps, the host stood east of the steps facing west;
translations.idiomatic: At the steps the host stood east of them, west-facing;

sentences.zh: 賓立於階西，東面。

translations.literal: the guest stood west of the steps facing east.
translations.idiomatic: the guest stood west of them, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人曰：「請公升。

translations.literal: The host said: "Please, my lord, ascend.
translations.idiomatic: The host said, "Please ascend, my lord."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某備將事，敢辭。

translations.literal: " The guest said: "I am prepared to perform the service—I venture to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "I am ready to serve—I venture to decline."

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「固請公升。

translations.literal: " The host said: "I firmly request my lord to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said, "I firmly ask you to ascend."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某敢固辭。

translations.literal: " The guest said: "I venture to firmly decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "I venture to decline again."

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「終請公升。

translations.literal: " The host said: "Finally I request my lord to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said, "Finally I ask you to ascend."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某敢終辭。

translations.literal: " The guest said: "I venture to decline finally.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "I must decline once more."

sentences.zh: 」主人升自阼階，立于席東，西向；

translations.literal: " The host ascended by the eastern steps and stood east of the mat facing west;
translations.idiomatic: " The host climbed the east steps and stood east of the seat, west-facing;

sentences.zh: 賓升自西階，立于席西，東向。

translations.literal: the guest ascended by the west steps and stood west of the mat facing east.
translations.idiomatic: the guest climbed the west steps and stood west of the seat, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者及庭，盥於洗，升自西階，入于東房，立于主人贊冠者之南，俱西面。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant reached the courtyard, washed at the lavabo, ascended the west steps, entered the east room, and stood south of the host cap-assistant—all facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant washed in the courtyard, climbed the west steps, entered the east room south of the host's cap-assistant—all west-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人贊冠者引皇子出，立于房戶外西，南面。

translations.literal: The host cap-assistant led the prince out to stand west outside the inner room door, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The host's cap-assistant led the prince out west of the inner room door, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊冠者取纚、櫛、簪箱，跪奠于皇子筵東端，興，席東少北，南面立。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant took the headband, comb, and hairpin box, knelt and set it at the east end of the prince's mat, rose, stood slightly north east of the mat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's cap-assistant knelt and set the headband, comb, and pin box at the east end of the prince's seat, then stood slightly north, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇子，賓、主俱即座。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the prince; guest and host both took their seats.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed to the prince; guest and host both sat.

sentences.zh: 皇子進，升席，南面坐。

translations.literal: The prince advanced, ascended the mat, and sat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The prince advanced, mounted the seat, and sat south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊冠者進筵前，北面，跪脫雙童髻置於箱，櫛畢，設纚。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant came before the mat facing north, knelt, removed the double child topknots into the box, combed, and set the headband.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's cap-assistant knelt north-facing before the seat, removed the double topknots into the box, combed, and set the headband.

sentences.zh: 賓降，盥，主從降。

translations.literal: The guest descended and washed; the host followed down.
translations.idiomatic: The guest descended to wash; the host followed.

sentences.zh: 賓東面辭曰：「願主不降。

translations.literal: The guest declined facing east: "I wish the host not to descend.
translations.idiomatic: The guest declined east-facing: "I wish the host not to descend."

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「公降辱，敢不從降。

translations.literal: " The host said: "When my lord descends it is an honor—I venture not to fail to descend.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said, "When you descend it honors me—I dare not fail to descend."

sentences.zh: 」賓既盥，詣西階。

translations.literal: " After the guest had washed, he went to the west steps.
translations.idiomatic: " After washing, the guest went to the west steps.

sentences.zh: 賓、主一揖一讓，升。

translations.literal: Guest and host bowed once and yielded once, then ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and host exchanged one bow and one yield, then ascended.

sentences.zh: 主人立于席後，西面，賓立於西階上，東面。

translations.literal: The host stood behind the mat facing west; the guest stood on the west steps facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood behind the seat west-facing; the guest on the west steps east-facing.

sentences.zh: 執緇布冠者升，賓降一等受之，右執頂，左執前，北面跪，冠，興，復西階上席後，東面立。

translations.literal: The black-cloth-cap bearer ascended; the guest descended one rank to receive it, right on top, left on front, knelt facing north, crowned him, rose, and returned behind the mat on the west steps facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The black-cloth-cap bearer ascended; the guest stepped down one rank, received it right on crown left on front, knelt north-facing to crown him, rose, and stood east-facing behind the west-step seat.

sentences.zh: 皇子興，賓揖皇子適房，賓、主俱坐。

translations.literal: The prince rose; the guest bowed to the prince to go to the inner room; guest and host both sat.
translations.idiomatic: The prince rose; the guest bowed him to the inner room; guest and host sat.

sentences.zh: 皇子服青衣素裳之服，出房戶西，南面立。

translations.literal: The prince dressed in green upper and plain lower garments, came out west of the inner room door, and stood facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The prince dressed in green upper and plain lower garments and came out south-facing west of the inner room door.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇子，皇子進，立于席後，南面。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the prince; the prince advanced and stood behind the mat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed the prince forward to stand south-facing behind the seat.

sentences.zh: 賓降，盥，主人從降，辭對如初。

translations.literal: The guest descended and washed; the host followed down; decline and reply as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The guest descended to wash; the host followed; decline and reply as before.

sentences.zh: 賓跪取爵於篚，興，洗，詣西階，賓、主一揖一讓，升，坐，主人立于席後，西面。

translations.literal: The guest knelt, took a cup from the basket, rose, rinsed it, went to the west steps; guest and host bowed once and yielded once, ascended and sat; the host stood behind the mat facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest knelt, took a cup from the basket, rinsed it, went to the west steps; guest and host exchanged bow and yield, ascended and sat; the host stood west-facing behind the seat.

sentences.zh: 賓詣酒尊所，酌酒進皇子筵前，北向立，祝曰：「旨酒既清，嘉薦亶時。

translations.literal: The guest went to the wine urn, poured wine, advanced before the prince's mat, stood north, and invoked: "Fine wine is clear; fine offerings timely.
translations.idiomatic: The guest poured wine at the urn, advanced before the prince's seat north-facing, and prayed: "Fine wine is clear; offerings timely.

sentences.zh: 始加元服，兄弟具來。

translations.literal: He first receives the additional cap; brothers all come.
translations.idiomatic: He first receives the cap of adulthood; brothers all attend.

sentences.zh: 孝友時格，永乃保之。

translations.literal: Filial piety and fraternity timely arrive; may he forever keep it.
translations.idiomatic: Filial piety and fraternity in season; may he keep it forever.

sentences.zh: 」皇子筵西拜爵，賓復西階上，東面答拜。

translations.literal: " The prince bowed to the wine west of the mat; the guest returned to the west steps facing east and answered the bow.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince bowed west of the seat; the guest returned to the west steps east-facing and answered.

sentences.zh: 執饌者薦籩、豆于皇子筵前。

translations.literal: Food-bearers presented baskets and stands before the prince's mat.
translations.idiomatic: Servers presented baskets and stands before the prince's seat.

sentences.zh: 皇子升座，左執爵，右取脯，扌需於棨，祭於籩、豆之間，祭酒，興，筵末坐，啐酒，執爵，興，降筵，奠爵，再拜，執爵興。

translations.literal: The prince ascended the seat, left hand on the cup, right taking dried meat, dipping on the stick, sacrificing between baskets and stands, sacrificing to the wine, rose, sat at the mat's end, tasted the wine, took the cup, rose, descended from the mat, set down the cup, bowed twice, took up the cup and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The prince sat on the seat, cup in left hand, took dried meat right, dipped on the stick, offered between baskets and stands and to the wine, rose, sat at the seat's end, tasted the wine, descended, set down the cup, bowed twice, and rose with the cup.

sentences.zh: 賓答拜。

translations.literal: The guest answered the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 冠者升筵，跪奠爵於薦東，興，立於筵西，南面。

translations.literal: The crowner ascended the mat, knelt and set the cup east of the offering mat, rose, and stood west of the mat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The crowner knelt and set the cup east of the offering mat, rose, and stood south-facing west of the seat.

sentences.zh: 執饌者徹薦爵。

translations.literal: Food-bearers removed the offering cup.
translations.idiomatic: Servers removed the offering cup.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇子，皇子進，升筵，南向坐。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the prince; the prince advanced, ascended the mat, and sat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed the prince up to sit south-facing on the seat.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊冠者跪脫緇布冠，置於箱。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant knelt, removed the black cloth cap, and placed it in the box.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's cap-assistant knelt and put the black cloth cap in the box.

sentences.zh: 賓降二等，受遠遊冠，冠之。

translations.literal: The guest descended two ranks, received the far-travel cap, and crowned him.
translations.idiomatic: The guest stepped down two ranks, took the far-travel cap, and crowned him.

sentences.zh: 皇子興，賓揖皇子適房，賓、主俱坐。

translations.literal: The prince rose; the guest bowed to the prince to go to the inner room; guest and host both sat.
translations.idiomatic: The prince rose; the guest bowed him to the inner room; guest and host sat.

sentences.zh: 皇子服朝服，出房戶西，南面立。

translations.literal: The prince dressed in court robes, came out west of the inner room door, and stood facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The prince dressed in court robes and came out south-facing west of the inner room door.

sentences.zh: 賓、主俱興，賓揖皇子，皇子進，立于席後，南面。

translations.literal: Guest and host both rose; the guest bowed to the prince; the prince advanced and stood behind the mat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and host rose; the guest bowed the prince forward south-facing behind the seat.

sentences.zh: 賓詣尊所，取爵酌酒，進皇子筵前，北向立，祝曰：「旨酒既湑，嘉薦伊脯。

translations.literal: The guest went to the urn, took a cup, poured wine, advanced before the prince's mat, stood north, and invoked: "Fine wine is rich; fine offerings are dried meat.
translations.idiomatic: The guest poured at the urn, advanced before the seat north-facing, and prayed: "Wine is rich; offerings are dried meat.

sentences.zh: 乃申其服，禮儀有序。

translations.literal: Now he puts on his dress; rites and observances are in order.
translations.idiomatic: Now he dons his dress; rites are in order.

sentences.zh: 祭此嘉爵，承天之祜。

translations.literal: Sacrifice with this fine cup; receive Heaven's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Offer this fine cup; receive Heaven's blessing.

sentences.zh: 」皇子筵西拜，受爵，祭饌如初禮。

translations.literal: " The prince bowed west of the mat, received the cup, and sacrificed food as in the first rite.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince bowed west of the seat, received the cup, and offered food as in the first rite.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇子進，升席，南面坐。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the prince to advance; he ascended the mat and sat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed the prince up to sit south-facing.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊冠者跪脫進賢冠，賓降三等，受冕，冠之。

translations.literal: The guest's cap-assistant knelt and removed the advancement-worthy cap; the guest descended three ranks, received the coronet, and crowned him.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant knelt and removed the advancement-worthy cap; the guest stepped down three ranks, took the coronet, and crowned him.

sentences.zh: 每冠，皆贊冠者設簪結纓。

translations.literal: At each crowning, the cap-assistant set hairpin and tied cap tassel.
translations.idiomatic: At each crowning the cap-assistant set pin and tied the cap tassel.

sentences.zh: 皇子興，賓揖皇子適房，服袞冕以出方房戶西，南面。

translations.literal: The prince rose; the guest bowed to the prince to go to the inner room; dressed in dragon robes and came out square west of the inner room door facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The prince rose; the guest bowed him to the inner room; he emerged in dragon robes south-facing west of the inner room door.

sentences.zh: 賓揖皇子，進，立于席後，南面。

translations.literal: The guest bowed to the prince; he advanced and stood behind the mat facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed the prince forward south-facing behind the seat.

sentences.zh: 賓詣酒尊所，取爵酌酒進皇子，祝曰：「旨酒令芳，籩豆有楚。

translations.literal: The guest went to the wine urn, took a cup, poured wine, advanced to the prince, and invoked: "Fine wine is fragrant; baskets and stands are full.
translations.idiomatic: The guest poured wine at the urn, advanced to the prince, and prayed: "Wine is fragrant; baskets and stands are full.

sentences.zh: 鹹加其服，肴升折俎。

translations.literal: All add their dress; delicacies rise on the broken tray.
translations.idiomatic: All dress is added; delicacies rise on the broken tray.

sentences.zh: 承天之慶，受福無疆。

translations.literal: Receive Heaven's celebration; receive blessing without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Receive Heaven's celebration; blessing without end.

sentences.zh: 」皇子筵西拜，受爵。

translations.literal: " The prince bowed west of the mat and received the cup.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince bowed west of the seat and received the cup.

sentences.zh: 執饌者薦籩、豆，設俎于其南。

translations.literal: Food-bearers presented baskets and stands and set a tray south of them.
translations.idiomatic: Servers presented baskets and stands and set a tray south of them.

sentences.zh: 皇子升筵坐，執爵，祭脯棨。

translations.literal: The prince ascended the mat and sat, holding the cup, sacrificing dried meat on the stick.
translations.idiomatic: The prince sat on the seat with the cup and offered dried meat on the stick.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者取鸑一以授皇子，皇子奠爵于薦西，興，受，坐，祭，左手嚌之，興，加於俎。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant took one sliced bird and handed it to the prince; the prince set the cup west of the offering mat, rose, received it, sat, sacrificed, tasted with the left hand, rose, and placed it on the tray.
