translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant gave one sliced bird; the prince set the cup west of the mat, rose, received it, sat to offer, tasted left-handed, rose, and set it on the tray.

sentences.zh: 皇子坐，涚手執爵，祭酒，興，筵末坐，啐酒，降筵西，南面坐，奠爵，再拜，執爵興。

translations.literal: The prince sat, rinsed his hands, took the cup, sacrificed to the wine, rose, sat at the mat's end, tasted the wine, descended west of the mat, sat facing south, set down the cup, bowed twice, took up the cup and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The prince sat, rinsed his hands, took the cup, offered to the wine, rose, sat at the seat's end, tasted the wine, descended west south-facing, set down the cup, bowed twice, and rose with the cup.

sentences.zh: 賓答拜。

translations.literal: The guest answered the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 皇子升筵坐，奠爵於薦東，興。

translations.literal: The prince ascended the mat and sat, set the cup east of the offering mat, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The prince sat on the seat, set the cup east of the offering mat, and rose.

sentences.zh: 贊冠者引皇子降，立於西階之東，南面。

translations.literal: The cap-assistant led the prince down to stand east of the west steps facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The cap-assistant led the prince down east of the west steps, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 初，皇子降，賓降自西階，直西序東面立。

translations.literal: At first, when the prince descended, the guest descended the west steps and stood east of the west wing facing east.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince descended, the guest came down the west steps and stood east-facing east of the west wing.

sentences.zh: 主人降自東階，直東序西面立。

translations.literal: The host descended the east steps and stood west of the east wing facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host came down the east steps and stood west-facing west of the east wing.

sentences.zh: 賓少進，字之曰：「禮儀既備，令月吉日。

translations.literal: The guest advanced slightly and conferred the style name: "The rites and observances are complete; on this auspicious day of this month.
translations.idiomatic: The guest stepped forward to confer the style name: "Rites are complete on this good day of this month.

sentences.zh: 昭告其字，爰字孔嘉。

translations.literal: Proclaim his style name; how fine the style name.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim his style name—how fine the name.

sentences.zh: 君子攸宜，宜之於嘏。

translations.literal: Fitting for a gentleman; fitting for blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Fit for a gentleman; fit for blessing.

sentences.zh: 永受保之，曰孟某甫。

translations.literal: May he forever receive and keep it—styled Eldest So-and-so Fu.
translations.idiomatic: May he receive and keep it forever—styled Eldest So-and-so Fu.

sentences.zh: 」仲、叔、季唯其所當。

translations.literal: " Second, third, and fourth sons take what is appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: " Second, third, and fourth sons take what applies.

sentences.zh: 皇子曰：「某雖不敏，夙夜祗奉。

translations.literal: The prince said: "Though I am not adept, morning and night I reverently obey.
translations.idiomatic: The prince said, "Though I am not adept, morning and night I obey reverently."

sentences.zh: 」賓出，主人送于內門外，主人西面請賓曰：「公辱執事，請禮從者。

translations.literal: " The guest departed; the host saw him off outside the inner gate; the host faced west and requested of the guest: "My lord has honored us by undertaking the service—please treat the followers with rites.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest left; the host saw him off outside the inner gate and said west-facing, "You have honored us by serving—please treat my followers with courtesy."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某既得將事，敢辭。

translations.literal: " The guest said: "Having undertaken the service, I venture to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "Having served, I venture to decline."

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「敢固以請。

translations.literal: " The host said: "I venture to insist in requesting.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said, "I insist in asking."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某辭不得命，敢不從？

translations.literal: " The guest said: "I declined but received no permission—how dare I not obey?
translations.idiomatic: " The guest said, "I declined but was not excused—how dare I not obey?"

sentences.zh: 」賓就次，主人入。

translations.literal: " The guest went to his pavilion; the host entered.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest went to his pavilion; the host entered.

sentences.zh: 初，賓出，皇子東面見，諸親拜之，皇子答拜。

translations.literal: At first, when the guest departed, the prince received him facing east; kinsmen bowed to him; the prince returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest left, the prince received him east-facing; kinsmen bowed; the prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 皇子入見內外諸尊於別所。

translations.literal: The prince entered to see all inner and outer elders in a separate place.
translations.idiomatic: The prince entered to greet inner and outer elders in a separate chamber.

sentences.zh: 賓、主既釋服，改設席，訖，賓、贊俱出次，立於門西。

translations.literal: After guest and host had changed out of ritual dress and reset the mats, guest and assistant both went out to their pavilion and stood west of the gate.
translations.idiomatic: After guest and host changed dress and reset seats, guest and assistant went to their pavilion west of the gate.

sentences.zh: 主人出揖賓，賓報揖。

translations.literal: The host came out and bowed to the guest; the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The host came out and bowed; the guest returned it.

sentences.zh: 主人先入，賓、贊從之。

translations.literal: The host entered first; guest and assistant followed.
translations.idiomatic: The host entered first; guest and assistant followed.

sentences.zh: 至階，一揖一讓，升坐，俱坐。

translations.literal: At the steps, one bow and one yield; they ascended and sat; both sat.
translations.idiomatic: At the steps they exchanged bow and yield, ascended, and sat together.

sentences.zh: 會訖，賓立於西階上，贊冠者在北，少退，俱東面。

translations.literal: When the reception was finished, the guest stood on the west steps; the cap-assistant north of him, slightly back—all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: After the reception the guest stood on the west steps; the cap-assistant north of him, slightly back—all east-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人立于東階上，西面。

translations.literal: The host stood on the east steps facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood on the east steps, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 掌事者奉束帛之篚升，授主人于序端。

translations.literal: Stewards brought up a basket of bundled silk and handed it to the host at the end of the wing.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants brought a basket of bundled silk up to the host at the wing's end.

sentences.zh: 主人執篚少進，西面立。

translations.literal: The host held the basket and advanced slightly, standing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host held the basket, stepped forward slightly, and stood west-facing.

sentences.zh: 又掌事者奉幣篚升，立于主人後。

translations.literal: Another steward brought up a coin basket and stood behind the host.
translations.idiomatic: Another attendant brought a coin basket and stood behind the host.

sentences.zh: 幣篚升，牽馬者牽兩馬入，陳於門內，三分庭一在南，北首西上。

translations.literal: The coin basket was raised; horse-leaders led two horses in and arrayed them inside the gate—one-third of the courtyard south, heads north ascending west.
translations.idiomatic: The coin basket rose; grooms led two horses in and arrayed them inside the gate—one-third of the courtyard south, heads north with west at their right.

sentences.zh: 賓還西階上，北面再拜。

translations.literal: The guest returned to the west steps and bowed twice facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The guest returned to the west steps and bowed twice north-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人進，立於楹間，贊冠者立于賓左，少退，俱北面再拜。

translations.literal: The host advanced and stood between the pillars; the cap-assistant stood left of the guest, slightly back—all bowed twice facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The host advanced between the pillars; the cap-assistant stood left of the guest, slightly back—all bowed twice north-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人南面，賓、贊進，立于主人之右，俱南面東上。

translations.literal: The host faced south; guest and assistant advanced and stood right of the host—all facing south ascending east.
translations.idiomatic: The host faced south; guest and assistant advanced right of the host—all south-facing with east at their right.

sentences.zh: 主人授幣，賓受之，退，復位。

translations.literal: The host handed over the coins; the guest received them and withdrew to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The host handed over the coins; the guest received them and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 于主人授幣，掌事者又以幣篚授贊冠者。

translations.literal: As the host handed coins, stewards also handed the coin basket to the cap-assistant.
translations.idiomatic: As the host handed coins, attendants also gave the coin basket to the cap-assistant.

sentences.zh: 主人還阼階上，北面拜送，賓、贊降自西階，從者訝受幣。

translations.literal: The host returned to the eastern steps and bowed facing north in farewell; guest and assistant descended the west steps; followers received the coins with obeisance.
translations.idiomatic: The host returned to the east steps and bowed north in farewell; guest and assistant descended the west steps; followers received the coins with obeisance.

sentences.zh: 賓當庭實，東面揖，出，牽馬者從出，從者訝受馬於門外。

translations.literal: The guest filled the courtyard, bowed east, departed; horse-leaders followed out; followers received the horses with obeisance outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: The guest filled the courtyard, bowed east, and left; grooms followed; followers received the horses with obeisance outside the gate.

sentences.zh: 賓降，主人降。

translations.literal: The guest descended; the host descended.
translations.idiomatic: The guest descended; the host descended.

sentences.zh: 送賓於大門，西面再拜。

translations.literal: They saw the guest off at the great gate with a double bow facing west.
translations.idiomatic: They saw the guest off at the great gate with two bows west-facing.

sentences.zh: 若諸臣之嫡子三加，皆祝而冠，又祝而酌，又祝而字。

translations.literal: For legitimate sons of various ministers with three investitures, each crowning is invoked, each pouring is invoked, and each style-naming is invoked.
translations.idiomatic: For ministers' legitimate sons with three investitures, each crowning, each libation, and each style-naming receives an invocation.

sentences.zh: 庶子三加，既加，然後酌而祝之，又祝而字。

translations.literal: For secondary sons with three investitures, after the investiture they then pour and invoke, then invoke for the style name.
translations.idiomatic: For secondary sons with three investitures, after crowning they pour and invoke, then invoke for the style name.

sentences.zh: 其始冠皆緇布；

translations.literal: The first crowning is always black cloth;
translations.idiomatic: The first crowning always uses black cloth;

sentences.zh: 再加皆進賢；

translations.literal: the second crowning always advancement-worthy;
translations.idiomatic: the second always advancement-worthy;

sentences.zh: 其三加，一品之子以袞冕，二品之子以驚冕，三品之子以毳冕，四品之子以絺冕，五品之子以玄冕，六品至於九品之子以爵弁。

translations.literal: the third crowning: first-rank sons use dragon robes, second-rank sons startled robes, third-rank sons fine-fur robes, fourth-rank sons fine-silk robes, fifth-rank sons black robes, sixth through ninth-rank sons use cap and coronet.
translations.idiomatic: the third: first-rank sons dragon robes; second startled; third fine-fur; fourth fine-silk; fifth black; sixth through ninth cap and coronet.

sentences.zh: 其服從之。

translations.literal: Their garments follow accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Their garments match accordingly.

sentences.zh: 其即席而冠也，嫡子西面，庶子南面。

translations.literal: When crowning at the mat, legitimate sons face west; secondary sons face south.
translations.idiomatic: At the seat, legitimate sons face west; secondary sons face south.

sentences.zh: 其筮日，筮賓、贊，遂戒之，及其所以冠之禮，皆如親王。

translations.literal: Divining the day, divining guest and assistant, then admonishing them, and the manner of crowning—all as for imperial princes.
translations.idiomatic: Divining the day and guest and assistant, admonishing them, and the crowning rite—all follow the imperial prince's procedure.
